Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, adorn me during it [Ramadan] with modesty and chastity
And cover me during it with the garment of contentment and sufficiency
And guide me during it to justice and fairness

Arabic text: وَ آمِنِّيْ فِيْهِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَا أَخَافُ
Translation: And protect me during it from all that I fear
By Your protection, O Protector of the fearful
